item.title: Weekly Review: January 24, 2026
item.description: I hope everyone is having a nice weekend so far, and that those impacted by the inclement weather across much of the United States are staying safe. Living in Florida, it’s easy to lose sight of how most of the country is dealing with a major weather system, as it’s sunny and 75 degrees here.

item.title: Delta’s “Basic Business Class” Is Coming In 2026 — A Worse Product, But Not A New Lower Fare
item.description: Delta says it is introducing a new “Basic Business” fare that strips out things that used to come standard in the premium cabin. What's widely misunderstood is that this isn’t a new cheaper business class price point. It’s new restrictions on the lowest business fares so Delta can sell last minute seats to price-sensitive travelers without offering the same deal to customers who would have paid more money.
